subject: im
question: What is the value of Total Float for critical activities?
title: Critical Means Zero Spare
hook: Leave at 8:30 for a 9:00 train with a 30-minute journey: no spare time at all.
answer: The total float of critical activities is ZERO.
Total float = latest start - earliest start (= latest finish - earliest finish).
Critical activities lie on the longest path, so earliest and latest times are equal: no spare time.
Any delay in a critical activity delays the whole project by the same amount.
Together the critical activities form the critical path.
